sources.title: DRDetect - a Hugging Face Space by IbrahimSeven
sources.snippet: Upload images of both eyes, and receive a diagnosis indicating whether you need to see an ophthalmologist. The tool preprocesses images and uses a model to assess signs of diabetic retinopathy.
